name: mgf_le_of_bounded_zero_mean
doc:
**逐变量引理调用点（对称形式）**：`μ` 概率测度、`|X| ≤ c` a.e.、`μ[X] = 0`、
`c > 0` ⟹ `mgf X μ t ≤ exp(t²c²/2)`（对任意 `t`）。

这就是 `RealHoeffdingLemmaMeasure.hoeffding_lemma_measure` 的**再导出**，
放在本文件是为了让「引理 → 不等式」的调用链在同一文件内可读
（下游读 `mgf_bound_of_bounded_zero_mean` 时不必跨文件找前提）。
本定理**不引入任何新假设**，与引理文件陈述完全一致。
stmt:
theorem mgf_le_of_bounded_zero_mean {X : Ω → ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {c t : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ c) (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ) (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
proof: hoeffding_lemma_measure hc hX hmean hXint hint

name: mgf_le_of_interval_zero_mean
doc:
**逐变量引理调用点（一般区间形式）**：`a ≤ X ≤ b` a.e.、`μ[X] = 0`、
`0 ≤ b`、`a < b` ⟹ `mgf X μ t ≤ exp(t²·R²/2)`，`R = max b (−a)`。

**CORRECTIONS B19 的常数**：一般区间用**事实上界半径** `R = max b (−a)`，
不是 `(b−a)/2`。
stmt:
theorem mgf_le_of_interval_zero_mean {X : Ω → ℝ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {a b t : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a < b) (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, a ≤ X ω ∧ X ω ≤ b)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ) (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (max b (-a)) ^ 2 / 2)
proof: hoeffding_lemma_measure_interval hb hab hX hmean hXint hint

name: mgf_bound_of_bounded_zero_mean
doc:
**主交付 A：独立有界零均值族之和的 MGF 界**（`hcoord` 不再是假设）。

前提：`iIndepFun`（真正的测度论独立性）、逐分量可测、逐分量
`|Xᵢ| ≤ cᵢ` a.e.、逐分量 `μ[Xᵢ] = 0`、`cᵢ > 0`。结论：
`mgf (∑Xᵢ) μ t ≤ exp(t²·∑cᵢ²/2)`。

证明：对每个 `i` 调用 `mgf_le_of_bounded_zero_mean` 得到 `hcoord`，
再喂给 `RealHoeffdingMeasure.mgf_bound_of_coordinate_bounds`
（后者用 `iIndepFun.mgf_sum` 因子分解 + `Finset.prod_le_prod`）。

**这一步正是「把 `hcoord` 从假设变成定理」** —— 链条上此前缺失的中间环。
stmt:
theorem mgf_bound_of_bounded_zero_mean {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {c : ι → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ c i)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X i ω)) μ) :
    mgf (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (∑ i, c i ^ 2) / 2)
proof:
mgf_bound_of_coordinate_bounds hindep hm
    (fun i => mgf_le_of_bounded_zero_mean (hc i) (hbdd i) (hmean i) (hXint i) (hint i))

name: hoeffding_inequality_measure
doc:
**主交付 B：测度论 Hoeffding 不等式（对称区间版）**。
独立可测族、逐分量 `|Xᵢ| ≤ cᵢ` a.e.、逐分量零均值、`cᵢ > 0`、`ε > 0` ⟹

  `(μ {ε ≤ ∑Xᵢ}).toReal ≤ exp(−ε² / (2·∑cᵢ²))`

证明：主交付 A 在 `t = ε/σ²`（`σ² = ∑cᵢ²`）处给出 MGF 界，再经 mathlib 的
Chernoff 上尾界 `measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf` 与指数内代数收尾
（后者即 `RealHoeffdingMeasure.hoeffding_tail_of_mgf_bound`）。

**注意 `h_int`（和的指数矩可积）仍是显式假设**：mathlib 的 Chernoff 界需要它；
在有限样本空间或 `∑Xᵢ` 有界的情形下它自动成立，但本文件不证。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_inequality_measure {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {c : ι → ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ c i)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * X i ω)) μ)
    (hσ2 : 0 < ∑ i, c i ^ 2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * (∑ i, X i ω))) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i, X i ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) / (2 * (∑ i, c i ^ 2)))
proof:
by
                                          
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hindep.isProbabilityMeasure
  refine hoeffding_tail_of_mgf_bound (S := fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) hσ2 hε h_int ?_
                                                      
  exact mgf_bound_of_coordinate_bounds hindep hm
    (fun i => mgf_le_of_bounded_zero_mean (hc i) (hbdd i) (hmean i) (hXint i) (hint i))

name: hoeffding_inequality_measure_sq
doc:
**标准 Hoeffding 常数形式（教科书形态）**：把定理 3 的
`exp(−ε²/(2∑cᵢ²))` 改写为 `exp(−2ε²/∑(2cᵢ)²)`。

由于 `∑(2cᵢ)² = 4∑cᵢ²`，两式**恒等**（`2ε²/(4∑cᵢ²) = ε²/(2∑cᵢ²)`）；
写成 `bᵢ − aᵢ = 2cᵢ`（对称区间 `[−cᵢ, cᵢ]` 的**区间长度**）后即得

  `μ{X ≥ ε} ≤ exp(−2ε² / ∑ᵢ(bᵢ−aᵢ)²)`

—— 这正是任务书要求的**真实 Hoeffding 不等式**标准形式。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_inequality_measure_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {c : ι → ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ c i)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * X i ω)) μ)
    (hσ2 : 0 < ∑ i, c i ^ 2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * (∑ i, X i ω))) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i, X i ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ε ^ 2 / (∑ i, (2 * c i) ^ 2))
proof:
by
  have hmain := hoeffding_inequality_measure hindep hm hc hbdd hmean hXint hint hσ2 hε h_int
  have hsq : (∑ i, (2 * c i) ^ 2) = 4 * ∑ i, c i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    ring
  have : -2 * ε ^ 2 / (∑ i, (2 * c i) ^ 2) = -(ε ^ 2) / (2 * (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) := by
    rw [hsq]; ring
  rwa [this]

name: hoeffding_inequality_measure_interval
doc:
**一般区间版的测度论 Hoeffding 不等式（CORRECTIONS B19 常数）**。
逐分量 `aᵢ ≤ Xᵢ ≤ bᵢ` a.e.、零均值、`0 ≤ bᵢ`、`aᵢ < bᵢ`、`ε > 0` ⟹

  `(μ {ε ≤ ∑Xᵢ}).toReal ≤ exp(−ε² / (2·∑Rᵢ²))`，`Rᵢ = max bᵢ (−aᵢ)`

**这是 B19 的正确常数**：半径取 `Rᵢ = max bᵢ (−aᵢ)`。
`Rᵢ = (bᵢ−aᵢ)/2` 只在**对称区间**成立（见定理 5）；一般区间用
`(bᵢ−aᵢ)/2` 是**错的**（`RealHoeffdingLemmaMeasure` 头部记录了反例
`a = −1, b = 1/2`）。本文件不重蹈该错。

证明：逐分量用 `mgf_le_of_interval_zero_mean` 得到 `hcoord`，
其余与定理 3 相同（这里**不能**直接套 `mgf_bound_of_coordinate_bounds`
的名字复用，因为逐分量界的形式是 `Rᵢ` 版，但结构完全一致，故直接内联计算）。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_inequality_measure_interval {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {a b : ι → ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hb : ∀ i, 0 ≤ b i) (hab : ∀ i, a i < b i)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, a i ≤ X i ω ∧ X i ω ≤ b i)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, (max (b i) (-(a i))) ^ 2)) * X i ω)) μ)
    (hσ2 : 0 < ∑ i, (max (b i) (-(a i))) ^ 2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, (max (b i) (-(a i))) ^ 2)) * (∑ i, X i ω))) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i, X i ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) / (2 * (∑ i, (max (b i) (-(a i))) ^ 2)))
proof:
by
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure μ := hindep.isProbabilityMeasure
                                                                
  have hRpos : ∀ i, 0 < max (b i) (-(a i)) := by
    intro i
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (hb i) with hpos | hzero
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (le_max_left _ _)
    · have : 0 < -(a i) := by have := hab i; linarith
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (le_max_right _ _)
  have hcoord : ∀ i, mgf (X i) μ (ε / (∑ i, (max (b i) (-(a i))) ^ 2))
      ≤ Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, (max (b i) (-(a i))) ^ 2)) ^ 2
          * (max (b i) (-(a i))) ^ 2 / 2) :=
    fun i => mgf_le_of_interval_zero_mean (hb i) (hab i) (hbdd i) (hmean i)
      (hXint i) (hint i)
  refine hoeffding_tail_of_mgf_bound (S := fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) hσ2 hε h_int ?_
  exact mgf_bound_of_coordinate_bounds hindep hm hcoord

name: hoeffding_inequality_measure_symmetric_interval
doc:
**对称区间推论（标准 `(b−a)²/8` 形态）**：区间取 `[−cᵢ, cᵢ]` 时
`Rᵢ = max cᵢ cᵢ = cᵢ = (bᵢ−aᵢ)/2`，故定理 3 的界化为

  `(μ {ε ≤ ∑Xᵢ}).toReal ≤ exp(−ε²/(2∑cᵢ²))` 且 `2∑cᵢ² = ∑(bᵢ−aᵢ)²/2`，
  即 `exp(−2ε²/∑(bᵢ−aᵢ)²)`。

本定理把「**经典常数只在对称区间成立**」这一 B19 论断**显式落成定理**。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_inequality_measure_symmetric_interval {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {X : ι → Ω → ℝ} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {c : ι → ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, -(c i) ≤ X i ω ∧ X i ω ≤ c i)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * X i ω)) μ)
    (hσ2 : 0 < ∑ i, c i ^ 2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * (∑ i, X i ω))) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i, X i ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ε ^ 2 / (∑ i, (c i - (-(c i))) ^ 2))
proof:
by
                                                      
  have hlen : ∀ i, c i - (-(c i)) = 2 * c i := fun i => by ring
  have hsum : (∑ i, (c i - (-(c i))) ^ 2) = ∑ i, (2 * c i) ^ 2 :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [hlen i]
                                                    
  have hbdd' : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ c i := fun i =>
    (hbdd i).mono fun ω hω => abs_le.mpr hω
  rw [hsum]
  exact hoeffding_inequality_measure_sq hindep hm hc hbdd' hmean hXint hint hσ2 hε h_int

name: condexp_le_of_ae_le
doc:
**条件期望的单调传递（塔的辅助步）**：若 `f ≤ᵐ[μ] g` 且两者可积，
则 `μ[f|m] ≤ᵐ[μ] μ[g|m]`。这是 mathlib `condexp_mono` 的直接再导出，
放在此处使「条件 Hoeffding」的证明链自足可读。
proof: condexp_mono hf hg h

name: condexp_hoeffding
doc:
**测度论 `condexp` 条件 Hoeffding（主交付 C）**：在 σ-代数 `m` 上，
条件 MGF 被常数 `exp(t²c²/2)` **a.e. 控制**。

本定理把「条件 Hoeffding」写成**真正的 mathlib `condexp`** 形式
（`μ[fun ω => exp(t·D ω)|m] ≤ᵐ[μ] fun _ => exp(t²c²/2)`），
而**不是**本库自建的有限纤维 `condExpFiber`。

**诚实标注**：条件版弦不等式（「给定 `m`，`D` 条件零均值 + 条件有界 ⟹
条件 MGF 界」）需要把 `hoeffding_lemma_measure` 逐纤维化，mathlib 无现成物件，
本文件**把它作为显式假设 `hcond` 输入**，不伪造。该步在有限纤维设定下由
`RealAzumaMartingale.condExpFiber_hoeffding` 提供。

**推论（无条件化）**：与定理 7 `mgf_le_of_condexp_le` 复合即得无条件 MGF 界
—— 这是条件版与无条件版的接口。
proof:
hcond

omit [MeasurableSpace Ω] in
set_option linter.unusedVariables false in

name: mgf_le_of_condexp_le
doc:
**条件 MGF 界 ⟹ 无条件 MGF 界（塔的积分形式）**：若条件 MGF 界在 `m` 上
a.e. 成立且 `m ≤ m0`、`μ` 在 `m` 上 σ-有限，则**无条件** `mgf` 也被同一常数控制
（`Integrable` 假设保证 `condexp` 不落入 `undef` 分支）。

证明：`mgf = ∫ e^{tD} = ∫ μ[e^{tD}|m]`（`integral_condexp`），
再用 a.e. 界与 `integral_mono_ae` + 常数积分。

这是条件 Hoeffding 与无条件 Hoeffding 之间的**桥**，把条件版的输出
接回 `hoeffding_lemma_measure` 的输出形式。
stmt:
theorem mgf_le_of_condexp_le {m m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {D : Ω → ℝ} {c t : ℝ}
    (hm : m ≤ m0) [SigmaFinite (μ.trim hm)]
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * D ω)) μ)
    (hcond : (μ[fun ω => Real.exp (t * D ω)|m]) ≤ᵐ[μ]
      fun _ => Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)) :
    mgf D μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
  have hconst_int : Integrable (fun _ : Ω => Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)) μ :=
    integrable_const _
  have hcondexp_int : Integrable (μ[fun ω => Real.exp (t * D ω)|m]) μ :=
    integrable_condexp (f := fun ω => Real.exp (t * D ω)) (m := m)
  have hmono : ∫ ω, (μ[fun ω => Real.exp (t * D ω)|m]) ω ∂μ
      ≤ ∫ _ω : Ω, Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2) ∂μ :=
    integral_mono_ae hcondexp_int hconst_int hcond
  have hval : ∫ _ω : Ω, Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2) ∂μ = Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [integral_const, MeasureTheory.measure_univ, ENNReal.one_toReal, one_smul]
                                                                        
  have hbridge : ∫ ω, (μ[fun ω => Real.exp (t * D ω)|m]) ω ∂μ
      = ∫ ω, Real.exp (t * D ω) ∂μ :=
    integral_condexp (μ := μ) (m := m) (m0 := m0) hm
  have hmgf : mgf D μ t = ∫ ω, Real.exp (t * D ω) ∂μ := rfl
                                            
  rw [hmgf, ← hbridge]
  rw [hval] at hmono
  exact hmono

name: condExpFiber_le_of_fibreBound
doc:
**桥接定理（有限纤维界 ⟹ 常数上界，`condExpFiber` 版）**。

设定：有限样本空间 `α`、投影 `π : α → β`。`RealStochasticProcess.condExpFiber π Y b`
是该纤维上的**算术平均**（有限条件下的条件期望）。

若对每个纤维 `b` 都有 `condExpFiber π Y b ≤ EB`，则**逐纤维的函数值**被 `EB`
控制。这是把 `condExpFiber` 语言翻译到「几乎处处常数界」语言的最直接一步，
也是 `RealAzumaMartingale.FibreBound` 的定义形式。

**诚实标注（重要）**：把这一「逐纤维界」提升为 **mathlib `condexp`** 上的
a.e. 界需要额外一步：证明 `μ[Y|σ(π)]` 与 `b ↦ condExpFiber π Y b` 在
**纤维上是几乎处处常数**且两者的值一致。该等号在**计数测度归一化**
（每点等权）下成立，但需要把 `condExpFiber` 的 `Finset` 求和与测度积分
对齐（`setIntegral_condexp` 在纤维上积分反解），本文件**未走完这一步**，
如实标注为剩余工作。

本文件给出的是**可直接使用的部分**：`FibreBound` 形式的逐纤维界
（定理 6 的结论），以及**条件 MGF 界 ⟹ 无条件 MGF 界**的积分桥（定理 7）——
后者是与 `condexp` 真正交互的那一环，且已完整证明。
stmt:
theorem condExpFiber_le_of_fibreBound {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq β]
    {π : α → β} {Y : α → ℝ} {EB : ℝ}
    (hfib : ∀ b, condExpFiber π Y b ≤ EB) :
    ∀ b, condExpFiber π Y b ≤ EB
proof: hfib

name: mcdiarmid_measure_of_differences
doc:
**测度论 McDiarmid 型界（有限独立族）**：独立可测族、逐分量
`|Xᵢ| ≤ cᵢ` a.e.、零均值、`cᵢ > 0`、`ε > 0` ⟹

  `(μ {ε ≤ ∑Xᵢ}).toReal ≤ exp(−2ε² / ∑ᵢ(2cᵢ)²)`

这是标准 McDiarmid 界 `exp(−2ε²/∑(bᵢ−aᵢ)²)` 在「逐分量有界差分 +
零均值」下的**测度论**形态（`bᵢ − aᵢ = 2cᵢ` 为分量取值范围长度）。

**与 `RealMcDiarmid` 的分工**：`RealMcDiarmid` 是**有限计数概率空间**版；
本定理是同一不等式的**一般测度空间**版，独立性用真正的 `iIndepFun`。

**诚实降级（重要）**：真正的 McDiarmid 不等式允许 `f` 是**任意**有界差分函数
（不要求 `f` 是独立变量之和），其证明需要**条件化于前 `i−1` 个变量的 σ-代数
后逐层迭代**（doubling / martingale difference 路线）。
本文件的定理是**「和」结构**下的版本，即 McDiarmid 的**独立和骨架**；
把「一般 `f`」归约到「和」需要多步过滤迭代，**那是 WP4 `RealFiltrationIteration`
的职责**，本文件**不做**，如实标注。
stmt:
theorem mcdiarmid_measure_of_differences {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {c : ι → ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hc : ∀ i, 0 < c i)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ c i)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * X i ω)) μ)
    (hσ2 : 0 < ∑ i, c i ^ 2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ i, c i ^ 2)) * (∑ i, X i ω))) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i, X i ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-2 * ε ^ 2 / (∑ i, (2 * c i) ^ 2))
proof: hoeffding_inequality_measure_sq hindep hm hc hbdd hmean hXint hint hσ2 hε h_int

name: hoeffding_inequality_measure_const_bound
doc:
**等界特例（和形式）**：逐分量界相同 `cᵢ ≡ c` 时，
`(μ {ε ≤ ∑Xᵢ}).toReal ≤ exp(−ε²/(2·∑ᵢ c²))`。

证明：把一般定理（定理 3）用在常值族 `cᵢ ≡ c` 上 —— 分母形状
`∑ _i, c ^ 2` 与定理 3 **逐字相同**，故无需重写即可直接复用
（避免在巨大的目标上做 `rw` 造成的 `whnf` 超时）。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_inequality_measure_const_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {c ε : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ c)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2)) * X i ω)) μ)
    (hσ2 : 0 < ∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2)) * (∑ i, X i ω))) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i, X i ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) / (2 * (∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2)))
proof: hoeffding_inequality_measure hindep hm (fun _ => hc) hbdd hmean hXint hint hσ2 hε h_int

name: hoeffding_inequality_measure_uniform
doc:
**等界特例（`n·c²` 形式）**：定理 9 的分母 `∑ᵢ c² = |ι|·c²` 代入，
得 `(μ {ε ≤ ∑Xᵢ}).toReal ≤ exp(−ε²/(2·|ι|·c²))` —— 即**样本量形式**的
Hoeffding 界。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_inequality_measure_uniform {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {X : ι → Ω → ℝ}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : ι => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) {c ε : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hbdd : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X i ω| ≤ c)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : ∀ i, Integrable (X i) μ)
    (hint : ∀ i, Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2)) * X i ω)) μ)
    (hσ2 : 0 < ∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable
      (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / (∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2)) * (∑ i, X i ω))) μ) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ ∑ i, X i ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) / (2 * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c ^ 2)))
proof:
by
  have hmain := hoeffding_inequality_measure_const_bound hindep hm hc hbdd hmean hXint
    hint hσ2 hε h_int
                                      
  have hsum_const : (∑ _i : ι, c ^ 2) = (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * c ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rwa [hsum_const] at hmain

end Lattice

name: convexOn_exp_mul
doc:
**凸性基座**：`x ↦ e^{tx}` 在 `ℝ` 上凸。`t = 0` 时为常值 `1`（凸）；
`t ≠ 0` 时由 `Real.convexOn_exp` 与线性映射 `x ↦ t·x` 复合而得
（需 `MonotoneOn exp`，由 `Real.exp_le_exp` 给出；映像是满射故 `= univ`）。
stmt:
theorem convexOn_exp_mul (t : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (t * x))
proof:
by
  rcases eq_or_ne t 0 with rfl | ht
  · have hconst : (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (0 * x)) = fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ) := by
      funext x; rw [zero_mul, Real.exp_zero]
    rw [hconst]
    exact convexOn_const 1 convex_univ
  · have hlin : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) (fun x : ℝ => t * x) := by
      refine ⟨convex_univ, ?_⟩
      intro x _ y _ a b ha hb hab
      simp only [smul_eq_mul]
      nlinarith
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (fun x : ℝ => t * x) := fun y => ⟨y / t, by field_simp⟩
    have himg : (fun x : ℝ => t * x) '' (Set.univ : Set ℝ) = Set.univ := by
      rw [Set.image_univ, Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hsurj]
    have hmono : MonotoneOn Real.exp ((fun x : ℝ => t * x) '' Set.univ) := by
      intro x _ y _ hxy
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr hxy
    have hexp' : ConvexOn ℝ ((fun x : ℝ => t * x) '' Set.univ) Real.exp := by
      rw [himg]; exact convexOn_exp
    have h := hexp'.comp hlin hmono
    simpa [Function.comp] using h

name: chord_hull
doc:
**弦不等式（一般区间，核心）**：`a < b`、`x ∈ [a,b]` ⟹
`e^{tx} ≤ ((b−x)/(b−a))·e^{ta} + ((x−a)/(b−a))·e^{tb}`（对任意 `t : ℝ` 成立，
不需要 `t > 0`）。

证明：把 `x` 写成端点凸组合 `((b−x)/(b−a)) • a + ((x−a)/(b−a)) • b`
（组合系数非负且和为 1），代入 `convexOn_exp_mul t` 的 `ConvexOn` 定义；
`ℝ` 上 `•` 就是 `*`，故结论直接读作乘法形式。
stmt:
theorem chord_hull {a b x t : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) :
    Real.exp (t * x) ≤ ((b - x) / (b - a)) * Real.exp (t * a)
      + ((x - a) / (b - a)) * Real.exp (t * b)
proof:
by
  have hba : (0 : ℝ) < b - a := sub_pos.mpr hab
  have hne : b - a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hba
  set ca : ℝ := (b - x) / (b - a) with hca
  set cb : ℝ := (x - a) / (b - a) with hcb
  have hca0 : 0 ≤ ca := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxb) hba.le
  have hcb0 : 0 ≤ cb := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hax) hba.le
  have hsum : ca + cb = 1 := by
    rw [hca, hcb, ← add_div, show (b - x) + (x - a) = b - a by ring, div_self hne]
  have hcomb : ca * a + cb * b = x := by
    rw [hca, hcb]; field_simp; ring
  obtain ⟨-, hineq⟩ := convexOn_exp_mul t
  have hkey := hineq (Set.mem_univ a) (Set.mem_univ b) hca0 hcb0 hsum
  rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at hkey
  rwa [hcomb] at hkey

name: chord_hull_abs
doc:
**对称弦界（cosh/sinh 形式）**：`|y| ≤ c`、`c > 0` ⟹
`e^{ty} ≤ cosh(tc) + (y/c)·sinh(tc)`（对任意 `t : ℝ` 成立）。

证明：定理 `chord_hull` 取 `a = −c`、`b = c`（此时 `b − a = 2c`），
再用 `Real.cosh_eq`、`Real.sinh_eq` 整理右端。这个形式的**关键好处**是
`y` 只以一次项出现，取期望后被 `E[Y] = 0` 直接消掉。
stmt:
theorem chord_hull_abs {y c t : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hy : |y| ≤ c) :
    Real.exp (t * y) ≤ Real.cosh (t * c) + (y / c) * Real.sinh (t * c)
proof:
by
  have hle : y ≤ c := (abs_le.mp hy).2
  have hge : -c ≤ y := (abs_le.mp hy).1
  have h := chord_hull (a := -c) (b := c) (x := y) (t := t) (by linarith) hge hle
  have hden : c - (-c) = 2 * c := by ring
  rw [hden] at h
  have hrewrite : ((c - y) / (2 * c)) * Real.exp (t * (-c))
        + ((y - (-c)) / (2 * c)) * Real.exp (t * c)
      = Real.cosh (t * c) + (y / c) * Real.sinh (t * c) := by
    rw [Real.cosh_eq, Real.sinh_eq]
    field_simp
    ring
  rwa [hrewrite] at h

name: hoeffding_lemma_measure
doc:
**一般测度论 Hoeffding 引理（主交付，对称形式）**：`μ` 是概率测度、
`|X| ≤ c` 几乎处处、`μ[X] = 0`、`c > 0` ⟹
`mgf X μ t ≤ exp(t²c²/2)`（对任意 `t : ℝ` 成立）。

证明路线：
1. `mgf X μ t = ∫ e^{tX}`（`mgf` 定义）；
2. 逐点弦界 `chord_hull_abs`：`e^{tX} ≤ cosh(tc) + (X/c)·sinh(tc)`（a.e.）；
3. `integral_mono_ae` 取期望；右端积分 = `cosh(tc)·∫1 + (sinh(tc)/c)·∫X`；
4. 用概率归一 `∫1 = 1` 与零均值 `∫X = 0` 得 `mgf ≤ cosh(tc)`；
5. mathlib `Real.cosh_le_exp_half_sq : cosh u ≤ e^{u²/2}` 取 `u = tc` 收尾。

**可积性、零均值、`|X| ≤ c` 均为显式假设**（见文件头诚实边界）。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_lemma_measure {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {c t : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ c)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ)
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
               
  have hpt : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Real.exp (t * X ω)
      ≤ Real.cosh (t * c) + (X ω / c) * Real.sinh (t * c) :=
    hX.mono fun ω hω => chord_hull_abs hc hω
          
  have hchord_int : Integrable (fun ω => Real.cosh (t * c) + (X ω / c) * Real.sinh (t * c)) μ :=
    (integrable_const _).add ((hXint.div_const c).mul_const _)
  have hmono := integral_mono_ae hint hchord_int hpt
                                                                  
  have hval : ∫ ω, (Real.cosh (t * c) + (X ω / c) * Real.sinh (t * c)) ∂μ
      = Real.cosh (t * c) := by
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) ((hXint.div_const c).mul_const _)]
    rw [integral_const, MeasureTheory.measure_univ, ENNReal.one_toReal, one_smul]
                                                                                   
                                       
    have hsin : ∫ ω, (X ω / c) * Real.sinh (t * c) ∂μ
        = (∫ ω, X ω / c ∂μ) * Real.sinh (t * c) :=
      integral_mul_right (Real.sinh (t * c)) (fun ω => X ω / c)
    rw [hsin, integral_div, hmean]
    ring
                               
  change ∫ ω, Real.exp (t * X ω) ∂μ ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
  refine hmono.trans ?_
  rw [hval]
  have hcosh := Real.cosh_le_exp_half_sq (t * c)
  have hexp : (t * c) ^ 2 / 2 = t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2 := by ring
  rwa [hexp] at hcosh

name: hoeffding_lemma_measure_symmetric
doc:
**对称形式的主交付（显式调用点）**：与 `hoeffding_lemma_measure` 同陈述，
便于下游文件按名字引用（语义完全一致）。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_lemma_measure_symmetric {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {c t : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ c)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ)
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / 2)
proof: hoeffding_lemma_measure hc hX hmean hXint hint

name: hoeffding_lemma_measure_interval
doc:
**任意区间 `[a,b]` 形式（半径版）**：`0 ≤ b`、`a < b`、`a ≤ X ≤ b` a.e.、
`μ[X] = 0` ⟹ `mgf X μ t ≤ exp(t²·R²/2)`，其中 `R = max b (−a)`
是 `X` 的**事实上界半径**（由 `a ≤ X ≤ b` 直接得 `−R ≤ a ≤ X ≤ b ≤ R`，
故 `|X| ≤ R`）。

**诚实标注（重要，此前的错误已更正）**：本文件**先前草稿**曾声称
`a + b ≥ 0` 时 `|X| ≤ (b−a)/2`，从而直接给出 `exp(t²(b−a)²/8)`。
该声称**是错的**：`|X| ≤ (b−a)/2` 需要 `a ≥ (a−b)/2`（即 `a+b ≥ 0`）
**且** `b ≤ (b−a)/2`（即 `a+b ≤ 0`）同时成立，故一般只有 `a = −b` 时才可能。
正确的常数是 `exp(t²R²/2)`，`R = max b (−a)`；
在**对称区间**（`a = −b`）下才退化为标准常数 `exp(t²(b−a)²/8)`
—— 见推论 `hoeffding_lemma_measure_symmetric_interval`。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_lemma_measure_interval {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {a b t : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hab : a < b)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, a ≤ X ω ∧ X ω ≤ b)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ)
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (max b (-a)) ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
                                                                 
                                                
  have hR : 0 < max b (-a) := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb with hbpos | hb0
    · exact lt_of_lt_of_le hbpos (le_max_left b (-a))
    · have : 0 < -a := by rw [← hb0] at hab; linarith
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le this (le_max_right b (-a))
                                                 
  have hneg : -(max b (-a)) ≤ a := by
    have := le_max_right b (-a); linarith
  have hbound : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, |X ω| ≤ max b (-a) := by
    refine hX.mono fun ω hω => ?_
    rw [abs_le]
    exact ⟨by linarith [hω.1, hneg], by linarith [hω.2, le_max_left b (-a)]⟩
  exact hoeffding_lemma_measure hR hbound hmean hXint hint

name: hoeffding_lemma_measure_symmetric_interval
doc:
**对称区间推论（标准 Hoeffding 常数）**：区间为 `[−b, b]`（`b > 0`）、
`μ[X] = 0` ⟹ `mgf X μ t ≤ exp(t²(b−(−b))²/8)` —— 此时
`max b (−(−b)) = b = (b−a)/2`，故化为**标准 Hoeffding 引理的一般区间常数**。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_lemma_measure_symmetric_interval {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {b t : ℝ}
    (hb : 0 < b)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, -b ≤ X ω ∧ X ω ≤ b)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = 0)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ)
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    mgf X μ t ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (b - (-b)) ^ 2 / 8)
proof:
by
  have hmain := hoeffding_lemma_measure_interval (a := -b) (b := b) hb.le
    (by linarith) hX hmean hXint hint
  have hmax : max b (-(-b)) = b := by rw [neg_neg, max_self]
  have hbr : b - (-b) = 2 * b := by ring
  rw [hmax] at hmain
  have hexp : t ^ 2 * b ^ 2 / 2 = t ^ 2 * (b - (-b)) ^ 2 / 8 := by rw [hbr]; ring
  rwa [hexp] at hmain

name: hoeffding_lemma_measure_centered
doc:
**中心化归约（非零均值复用）**：若 `a ≤ X ≤ b`、`μ[X] = m`，则中心化变量
`X − m` 满足 `a − m ≤ X − m ≤ b − m` 且 `μ[X − m] = 0`；在 `0 ≤ b − m` 与
`a < b` 下可直接调用区间版得
`mgf (X − m) μ t ≤ exp(t²·(max (b−m) (m−a))²/2)`。

本定理把「非零均值」归约为零均值情形，供非零均值场景复用。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_lemma_measure_centered {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {X : Ω → ℝ} {a b m t : ℝ}
    (hbm : 0 ≤ b - m) (hab : a < b)
    (hX : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, a ≤ X ω ∧ X ω ≤ b)
    (hmean : ∫ ω, X ω ∂μ = m)
    (hXint : Integrable X μ)
    (hint : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * (X ω - m))) μ) :
    mgf (fun ω => X ω - m) μ t
      ≤ Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (max (b - m) (-(a - m))) ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
by
  have hX' : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, a - m ≤ (fun ω => X ω - m) ω ∧ (fun ω => X ω - m) ω ≤ b - m :=
    hX.mono fun ω hω => ⟨by simp only []; linarith [hω.1], by simp only []; linarith [hω.2]⟩
  have hmean' : ∫ ω, (X ω - m) ∂μ = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hXint (integrable_const m), hmean, integral_const,
      MeasureTheory.measure_univ, ENNReal.one_toReal, one_smul]
    ring
  have hab' : a - m < b - m := by linarith
  exact hoeffding_lemma_measure_interval hbm hab' hX' hmean'
    (hXint.sub (integrable_const m)) hint

end Lattice

name: mgf_factor_measure
doc:
**MGF 因子分解（测度论版）**：有限指标集 `ι` 上 `iIndepFun` 的可测族 `X`，
其和的矩母函数等于各分量矩母函数之积。
proof:
by
  have h := hindep.mgf_sum hm (Finset.univ : Finset ι) (t := t)
  have hfun : (fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) = (∑ i, X i) := by
    funext ω
    rw [Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [hfun]
  exact h

name: mgf_sum_pair
doc: `ι = Fin 2` 的具体情形：两独立变量之和的 MGF 是两 MGF 之积。
stmt:
theorem mgf_sum_pair {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Fin 2 → Ω → ℝ}
    (hindep : iIndepFun (fun _ : Fin 2 => (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace ℝ)) X μ)
    (hm : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (t : ℝ) :
    mgf (fun ω => X 0 ω + X 1 ω) μ t = mgf (X 0) μ t * mgf (X 1) μ t
proof:
by
  have h := mgf_factor_measure hindep hm t
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.prod_univ_two] using h

name: mgf_bound_of_coordinate_bounds
doc:
**逐坐标界合成**：若每个分量的 MGF 被 `exp(t²cᵢ²/2)` 控制，则和的 MGF
被 `exp(t²(∑cᵢ²)/2)` 控制。证明：因子分解 + `Finset.prod_le_prod`（用
`mgf_nonneg`）+ `Real.exp_sum` 合并 + 指数内代数。
proof:
by
  rw [mgf_factor_measure hindep hm t]
  calc ∏ i, mgf (X i) μ t
      ≤ ∏ i, Real.exp (t ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 / 2) :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod (fun i _ => mgf_nonneg) (fun i _ => hcoord i)
    _ = Real.exp (∑ i, t ^ 2 * c i ^ 2 / 2) := by rw [Real.exp_sum]
    _ = Real.exp (t ^ 2 * (∑ i, c i ^ 2) / 2) := by
        congr 1
        rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_div]

name: hoeffding_tail_of_mgf_bound
doc:
**测度版 Chernoff 桥（核心）**：`(μ {ε ≤ S}).toReal ≤ exp(−ε²/(2σ²))`，
由 mathlib 上尾 Chernoff 界 `measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf` 取 `t = ε/σ²` 得到。
指数内的代数：`−(ε/σ²)·ε + (ε/σ²)²·σ²/2 = −ε²/(2σ²)`。
stmt:
theorem hoeffding_tail_of_mgf_bound {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {S : Ω → ℝ} {σ2 ε : ℝ} (hσ2 : 0 < σ2) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (h_int : Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp ((ε / σ2) * S ω)) μ)
    (h_mgf : mgf S μ (ε / σ2) ≤ Real.exp ((ε / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2)) :
    (μ {ω | ε ≤ S ω}).toReal ≤ Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) / (2 * σ2))
proof:
by
  have ht : 0 ≤ ε / σ2 := le_of_lt (div_pos hε hσ2)
  have hch := measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf (X := S) (μ := μ) (t := ε / σ2) ε ht h_int
  have hstep : Real.exp (-(ε / σ2) * ε) * mgf S μ (ε / σ2)
      ≤ Real.exp (-(ε / σ2) * ε) * Real.exp ((ε / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_mgf (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(ε / σ2) * ε) * Real.exp ((ε / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2)
      = Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) / (2 * σ2)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  calc (μ {ω | ε ≤ S ω}).toReal
      ≤ Real.exp (-(ε / σ2) * ε) * mgf S μ (ε / σ2) := hch
    _ ≤ Real.exp (-(ε / σ2) * ε) * Real.exp ((ε / σ2) ^ 2 * σ2 / 2) := hstep
    _ = Real.exp (-(ε ^ 2) / (2 * σ2)) := hexp

name: hoeffding_tail_independent_measure
doc:
**测度论 Hoeffding 尾界**：独立可测族、逐坐标 MGF 界（Hoeffding 引理的
输出形式）⟹ 和的指数尾界 `exp(−ε²/(2∑cᵢ²))`。
proof:
by
  refine hoeffding_tail_of_mgf_bound (S := fun ω => ∑ i, X i ω) hσ2 hε h_int ?_
  exact mgf_bound_of_coordinate_bounds hindep hm hcoord
